text: Stands 10 s with balance ON: True; recovers from 0.2 s pushes up to 125 N forward / 125 N sideways (v2 capsule model: 175 N). COM +20 mm from the ankle axis (foot centre +60 mm, heel −60, toe +180). Plain PD (balance OFF) falls in ~2 s: the capped joint gains in series (hip, knee, ankle) are softer than the gravity stiffness m·g·h. That is a controller limit, not a COM problem.
